lead.t: Leads to Multiple Organ Dysfunction Syndrome (MODS): anuria, acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS), hepatic necrosis, and disseminated intravascular coagulation (DIC).

b: Figure: Severe systemic inflammation and microcirculatory dysfunction can affect the lungs, kidneys, liver, brain, cardiovascular system and haematological system.
MODS is progressive dysfunction of two or more organ systems in an acutely ill patient such that homeostasis cannot be maintained without intervention.
Common triggers: severe sepsis/septic shock, major trauma and prolonged shock, severe pancreatitis, major burns and complex postoperative complications.
